notes.title: Dev Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Here's a small End of May Dev Update to let you all know that development is progressing smoothly!
There's not much new to show you this time, as in the last few weeks the main focus mostly lied on technical stuff - Bugs have been fixed, performance has been optimized, game mechanics have been polished, and more playthrough statistics are finally making their way into the player profile!

Still, there has been quite a bit of progress on the game world as well, with new areas and regions added, or previous ones expanded.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/d7e868a427a50440a3612b5cbca6dafb5ecb7dc7.gif[/img]
[i]With the weather being like this outside, simply staying in bed always seems like a solid option.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/9802c5cd40e334daac6998408641dc21c0e9b702.gif[/img]
[i]Unless you're up for some brave adventuring, that is. This abandoned mine lies just waiting to be explored.[/i]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/5e9a20c9c07f6a4ad1549b57d62a6483e874de08.gif[/img]
[i]These little creatures really seem to enjoy their favorite relaxation spot![/i]


[hr][/hr]
That's it for now! Have a great day, and until next time!

notes.title: Demo Release and 1.03 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Yay! The Demo of A Sister's Journey has just launched this week, alongside Steam Next Fest!
The festival is already going strong, with so many amazing games to play, and if you want to give the A Sister's Journey Demo a shot, you can right now!

Additionally, as a little heads up: If you want to, but simply don't have enough time to try the demo during this Next Fest, don't worry! The demo will stay up for a while longer after that, so everyone who likes to try the game will have the chance to do so!


There have already been a lot of people trying the demo, and I want to shout out a huge Thank You to all of you, for playing the game, for your positive, kind and encouraging words on various channels, but also your valuable feedback!

I've been working hard on various small hotfixes during the last few days, listened to your feedback to make several adjustments especially regarding combat, and added a few much requested features. There's still more to come and being worked on, but for now, [b]here's the first patch and the patch notes for demo version 1.03 : [/b]

[list]
[*]Added the option to always dash in the direction you're currently facing.

[*]Added/Fixed that you can now dodge smaller bullets and enemies while dashing.

[*]Added an additional accessibility option (Spiritual Guidance) for weapon shots to cost no energy.

[*]Made several adjustments to the first boss fight, to make it both more approachable regarding managing the adds and your energy, and give more visual cues.

[*]Adjusted the vertical climb section right after the second boss to make it more approachable.

[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent picking up a Battery Core from the ground when facing away from it.

[*]Fixed a bug that caused shots fired with the Rapid Pulse Rifle to not always be able to travel above 1-tile high ledges.

[*]Made slight adjustments to the animations and mechanics so that when firing upwards, the bullets are a bit more aligned to the center of where the player stands.

[*]Disabled the ability to swap weapons until the Energy Core is found, to prevent accidentally switching to the broken Impact Cannon during combat at the beginning of the game.

[*]Made the first cave entrance in the tutorial section more visible. (There's also a minor shader bug going on at this place, which makes the doorway hard to see in some cases, which will be fixed soon as well).

[*]Added a little hint to the first room in Infested Caves.
[/list]


That's a wrap! There are still a few more rare, and sometimes rather elusive bugs needing to be fixed, and some further improvements I've already planned, so I get right back to work. In the meantime, I wish you all a great time with the demo!

notes.title: A Sister's Journey goes Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I hope all of you had a great start in the new year, and we too couldn't wait to hop right into it and start it with a bang!


[h2]Announcement Time![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/99bbf1905161b4bac5e6b8985ed7d2da71cba6fc.png[/img]

The next edition of the Steam Next Fest is right around the corner, starting on Feb. 6th - and A Sister's Journey will be part of it! That's right, I'm thrilled to announce that in less than two weeks you'll be able to take a shot at the game yourself, when the new and freshly prepared Demo Version launches for the first time!

Keep your eyes peeled for more news in the following days, and if you really don't want to miss anything and be there right when the Demo launches, make sure to wishlist and follow the game!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]All Pixels On Deck[/h3]

My Steam Deck also arrived several weeks ago, and I couldn't wait putting the game on it first thing. It was immensely satisfying to see the game boot up and run almost flawlessly right out of the box - and especially since A Sister's Journey is built with a custom engine, this definitely felt like a huge step.

I've fixed all encountered bugs so far, done some further tweaks and optimizations, and now it feels almost ready to go!
There are still some minor issues to take care of, but other than that it feels super satisfying to play A Sister's Journey on the Deck, and playing the Demo from start to finish has been a blast.

So if you own a Steam Deck, you can try it out yourself soon, too!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Main Menu[/h3]

No game is complete without one - And every project in development truly feels like finally becoming a real game once you give it a proper main menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/9670bb8f0b587d3db0ec515136bd7a42dca3f9cc.gif[/img]
And while it often just functions as a simple stop on your way to start the real thing, it also still is the very first thing players see of a game, therefore I took a lot of care so everyone feels warmly invited and welcomed into this wondrous world, waiting to be explored.

[hr][/hr]

Most of the work in the recent weeks was focused on preparing the demo, testing and optimizing, but a lot of progress has been made on the game itself, too! So enjoy a few more new scenes and teasers, some of which you'll likely be able to directly explore in the demo yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/27e5cb690a0ba60e5397f8d96df7feda9e64d12e.gif[/img]
[i]It's probably better to keep your distance when this beam goes off.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/9c46a8e3163ac6d579f52f6acf58aebe5c85140e.gif[/img]
[i]Be quick, else you might get trapped. Or worse.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/90dc2afad590a3878eba1be1ddb638e681424c99.gif[/img]
[i]Calm and relaxing, this tranquil area invites for a small break on your long journey.[/i]



Thanks for reading, and stay tuned for the next update, the launch of the demo, and the upcoming Next Fest!

notes.title: Dev Update May 2022 - Lots of progress!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

A lot of progress has been made on the development of [b]A Sister's Journey[/b] in the past few months, and I gladly want to share some of it with you today!


[h2]New Areas[/h2]

Many additional of the lush and vibrant areas and biomes you will be able to explore on your journey have finally been brought to life, making them no longer rough concepts or crude level layouts only, but actually something real, and alive. Something truly inviting to be explored and to play around in, and most importantly, to share with you all!

Here's a small selection, hope you'll enjoy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/7ebfe1a7c6b7fcb1db829a368d965789128a515c.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/5ea57dea25c123154887a12b7b34e219a36b8227.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/4bff9588313c2de94de1e0c3d3509575ec5910d3.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/1667b378d6fb6bd60706cdbe237200da7d63cf1b.gif[/img]


There are still some more zones to come, so stay tuned! But most of the general layouts are finished by now, and the only thing missing is filling out the remaining levels, and creating some more (and then some!).
And lastly of course, populating the remaining areas with life: [b]friends, enemies, bosses, challenges, puzzles and secrets and cool things to discover[/b] - which definitely is the most fun part to design!


[hr][/hr]
[h2]Weapons and Effects[/h2]

All the [b]powerful and unique weapons[/b] you will come across during your travels are now fully implemented, have all their graphics done, all effects and animations designed, and all upgrades and functions are, well, functional!
There's a lot to be discovered about them in the game - with many upgrades, special mechanics, unique gameplay and rewarding progress accompanying you throughout your journey.

It's way too much to show here in this little update, and after all, it's much more fun to discover them by yourselves once you'll be able to play! But here are a few teasers of some of them, and their newly added animations and effects:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/ef9225f3ce8a5b2b2917763f87d4a4c1ef7a639b.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/6c1e7acacea9ef730ede621ace7a81411500c86d.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/8163d6f70a7a2e500e22ed4c2f84dfdfd9c676fc.gif[/img]


And while dealing some serious damage definitely is their primary function, it won't be the only area where they will prove useful. With this game being a metroidvania, and all the weapons playing a major role in it, you will not only progress through the game and unlock new areas by learning new skills and movement abilities, but of course through clever use of the unique weapon mechanics and abilities as well!

Here's an example of the [b]Bubble Gun[/b], which absolutely is one of my favorite weapons to play around with right now, allowing you to traverse over (dangerous!) fluids in a [i]pretty[/i] stylish way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41539201/813c4ad4d88b03531b82fd18a5f2c6c45b157dae.gif[/img]

I will have more of the weapons and their mechanics to share in the future, and if you'd like to see even more of A Sister's Journey and its development, you're very welcome to [b][url=https://twitter.com/asistersjourney]follow on Twitter[/url][/b] for more weekly updates, teasers, screenshots and videos!


That's it for now! Thanks so much for reading, and most of all for your tremendous support towards the game. It really means so much!
Me, I'm hopping right back into work now. First on the list for the next few days is completing the remaining UI elements for the inventory, map, and game menu, as well as finishing some more of the enemies and boss encounters - On which I hope to have more to share in the near future.
